CREATE TABLE `pc_artifact_heads` (
  `scope_id` varchar(256) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `family` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `artifact_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `revision` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `searchable_text` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `lifecycle_state` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `replacement_artifact_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `merged_into_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `governance_generation` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`scope_id`, `family`, `artifact_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `pc_artifact_heads_OBFK_1792659503573247` FOREIGN KEY (`scope_id`, `family`, `artifact_id`, `revision`) REFERENCES `test`.`pc_artifacts`(`scope_id`, `family`, `artifact_id`, `revision`) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT ,
  FULLTEXT KEY `ix_pc_artifact_heads_fts` (`searchable_text`) WITH PARSER space PARSER_PROPERTIES=(min_token_size=3,max_token_size=84) BLOCK_SIZE 16384,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_artifact_heads_revision_positive` CHECK ((`revision` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_artifact_heads_lifecycle_state` CHECK ((`lifecycle_state` in ('active','deprecated','retired'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_artifact_heads_governance_generation_nonnegative` CHECK ((`governance_generation` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_artifact_heads_replacement_deprecated` CHECK (((`replacement_artifact_id` is null) or (`lifecycle_state` = 'deprecated'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_artifact_heads_merge_target` CHECK (((`merged_into_id` is null) or ((`lifecycle_state` = 'deprecated') and (`merged_into_id` <> `artifact_id`) and (`replacement_artifact_id` is null))))
) ORGANIZATION INDEX DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC COMPRESSION = 'zstd_1.3.8' BLOCK_SIZE = 16384 TABLET_SIZE = 134217728 PCTFREE = 0
